svg.title: Marketplace data model
svg.text: Entity-relationship diagram for specs/001-marketplace-data-model. PostgreSQL 17. Source of truth: data-model.md.
No relationships: values are copied into
invoices and deals when they are created (R5).
The marker next to a table says how many of its rows one row on the other side has.
PK primary key, FK foreign key, UK unique. Money columns are bigint in minor units (*_minor).
Ledger entries are signed: + money into the account, − money out of it. The entries of one transfer sum to 0.
accounts: one company_wallet per company, plus the platform accounts escrow and bank_clearing (no company).
